info.name: Render Public Audit Logs One-Off Jobs API

params.name: cursor
params.description: The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

params.name: status
params.description: Filter for the status of the job (`pending`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, or `canceled`)

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Filter for jobs created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Filter for jobs created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: startedBefore
params.description: Filter for jobs started before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: startedAfter
params.description: Filter for jobs started after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: finishedBefore
params.description: Filter for jobs finished before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

params.name: finishedAfter
params.description: Filter for jobs finished after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp)

items.docs: List jobs for the provided service that match the provided filters. If no filters are provided, all jobs for the service are returned.
Create a one-off job using the provided service. For details, see [One-Off Jobs](https://render.com/docs/one-off-jobs).
Retrieve the details of a particular one-off job for a particular service.
Cancel a particular one-off job for a particular service.
